page_review.title: door _Prison Door_metal_old -12MB
page_review.author: Mehdi Shahsavan
page_review.download_modal_terms: Author must be credited. Commercial use is allowed.
page_review.visible_geometry: Rusty barred prison door with lever and a rectangular frame. Viewer presents two spatially separate door/frame poses; local inspection must identify one complete closed assembly and preserve the source.

license_dependency_review: Four embedded 2048 px texture maps, no separate map terms on page. USDZ metadata names the same account URL as adventurer and records CC-BY-4.0 and exact source URL.
duplicate_remote_review: Selected closed assembly fingerprint differs from all seven accepted doors.
local_geometry_review: Original USDZ has two spatially separate copies of the same door/frame: closed Null and open display copy Null_1. Selected derivative removes only Null_1, retaining the closed source meshes/UVs/materials and original USDZ. Inspect attempt 000002 inventories the selected copy.

selected_source.operation: Remove only the spatially separate open display-copy prim subtree Null_1; retain the original closed Null subtree, materials and embedded maps. Original USDZ remains untouched.
